item.title: Use mktemp for worktree temp directories
item.intent: Worktree temp directories must use unpredictable paths via mktemp -d, not a predictable PID-based pattern — preventing symlink attacks and temp directory collisions.
steps: Replace the predictable path construction with mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/aishore-wt-${ITEM_ID}.XXXXXX"
Ensure cleanup still works with the mktemp-generated path
Verify git worktree add works with the new path

acceptanceCriteria.text: Worktree directories use mktemp instead of predictable PID paths
No predictable PID-based temp path construction for worktrees
